description: Compute an itemised estimate of ending a lease early: notice-period rent, break fee, re-letting fee, rent until re-let, deposit credit and net cost vs staying. Use when the user asks what breaking their lease will cost. Do NOT use to weigh breaking vs subletting vs staying - use compare_options.

break_fee_months.description: Early-termination (break) fee stated in the lease, in months' rent, e.g. 2. Default 0 = no break clause

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code used only to label amounts, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR. Default USD

deposit.description: Security deposit held by the landlord, non-negative amount, e.g. 2200. Default 0

expected_relet_months.description: Expected months until a replacement tenant moves in, e.g. 0.5 for about two weeks. Default 1

landlord_mitigates.description: Whether the landlord must try to re-let and offset rent (duty to mitigate). Default true; false = liable for all remaining rent

monthly_rent.description: Current monthly rent as a positive number in the lease currency, e.g. 2200

months_remaining.description: Months left on the lease including the current month, positive number, e.g. 7

notice_months.description: Notice period required by the lease, in months, e.g. 2; cannot exceed months_remaining. Default 2 (capped at months_remaining) if no break fee, else 0

reletting_fee.description: Fixed re-letting/advertising/cleaning fee stated in the lease, non-negative amount, e.g. 300. Default 0

name: estimate_break_cost

assumptions.description: Assumptions applied in the estimate (fee, notice, mitigation, deposit)

breakdown.description: Itemised cost components of breaking the lease

deposit_credit.description: Deposit credited against the cost, capped at the cost of the path used for net_break_cost

reletting_fee.description: Fixed re-letting fee from the lease

rent_during_notice.description: Rent owed for the notice period (monthly_rent x notice_months)

rent_until_relet_if_liable.description: Rent owed until a replacement tenant is found (or to lease end if the landlord does not mitigate)

currency.description: Currency code the amounts are labelled in

disclaimer.description: Informational, not-legal-advice disclaimer to show with the result

net_break_cost.description: Estimated net cost to break the lease after deposit credit: with a break fee, the cheaper of the break-clause and no-clause paths; with no break fee, the no-clause path. Floored at 0

net_without_break_clause.description: Net cost on the no-break-clause path (rent until relet + re-letting fee, less deposit)

path_used.description: Which path net_break_cost uses: break_clause (notice rent + break fee + re-letting fee) or no_clause (rent until relet + re-letting fee)

stay_cost.description: Total rent if the lease is kept to term, for comparison

title: Estimate break cost
